name: Republic Day Sale
note: Amazon and Flipkart both run a late-January sale; the exact window shifts year to year.

name: Holi Sale
note: Approximate. Some years this runs in early March, some in late February — February is not listed because the sale usually lands after the month turns.

name: Summer Sale
note: Approximate. Amazon's Summer Sale and Flipkart's equivalent span late April into May.

name: Prime Day
note: Amazon only — Flipkart has no direct equivalent. Usually mid-July.

name: Great Indian Festival / Big Billion Days
note: The biggest window of the year. Amazon calls it the Great Indian Festival, Flipkart the Big Billion Days; they usually overlap and can start in late September.

name: Diwali / Dhanteras Sale
note: Approximate, and it moves with the lunar calendar — in some years it falls entirely in October and overlaps the Great Indian Festival window.

name: Year End Sale
note: Approximate. Late December, before the new year.
